title_zh: NEWS IN 10 每日新聞英語｜11 月 20 日

stories.headline_en: AI Models Need Less Data for Materials Discovery
stories.headline_zh: 人工智慧模型發現新材料所需資料量減少

sentences.en: Researchers found AI models can predict new material properties with less data.
sentences.zh: 研究人員發現，人工智慧模型能以更少的資料預測新材料的特性。

sentences.en: They discovered that 90% of training data could be discarded without losing accuracy.
sentences.zh: 他們發現，90% 的訓練資料可以被丟棄，而不會損失準確性。

sentences.en: This makes AI-driven materials development faster and more cost-effective.
sentences.zh: 這使得人工智慧驅動的材料開發更快且更具成本效益。

sentences.en: The findings apply to various materials, including metals and complex alloys.
sentences.zh: 這些發現適用於各種材料，包括金屬和複雜的合金。

sentences.en: Such advancements could greatly streamline the discovery of novel substances.
sentences.zh: 這些進展可以大幅簡化新穎物質的發現過程。

stories.headline_en: Taiwan Boosts F-16V Fighter Fleet Upgrade Budget
stories.headline_zh: 臺灣增加 F-16V 戰機機隊升級預算

sentences.en: Taiwan approved an extra budget for its F-16V fighter jet upgrades.
sentences.zh: 臺灣批准了一筆額外預算，用於升級其 F-16V 戰鬥機。

sentences.en: An additional NT$42.8 billion will enhance electronic warfare systems.
sentences.zh: 額外的新臺幣 428 億元將用於提升電子作戰系統。

sentences.en: This 17% increase pushes the total program cost to NT$290 billion.
sentences.zh: 這項 17% 的增幅使該計畫的總成本達到新臺幣 2900 億元。

sentences.en: The funding aims to sharpen combat readiness and integrate drone drills.
sentences.zh: 這筆資金旨在提高作戰準備狀態並整合無人機演習。

sentences.en: Taiwan seeks to strengthen its defense capabilities against rising regional pressure.
sentences.zh: 臺灣尋求加強其國防能力，以應對日益增長的區域壓力。

stories.headline_en: World Bank Reports $4 Trillion Finance Gap for Small Businesses
stories.headline_zh: 世界銀行報告：小型企業面臨 4 兆美元融資缺口

sentences.en: Developing countries face a $4 trillion finance gap for small businesses.
sentences.zh: 開發中國家的小型企業面臨 4 兆美元的融資缺口。

sentences.en: This limits their ability to grow, trade, and create jobs effectively.
sentences.zh: 這限制了它們有效成長、貿易和創造就業機會的能力。

sentences.en: Micro, small, and medium enterprises, or MSMEs, employ 75% of workers.
sentences.zh: 微型、小型和中型企業（MSMEs）僱用了 75% 的勞工。

sentences.en: Lack of digital records and regulatory burdens are key constraints.
sentences.zh: 缺乏數位紀錄和監管負擔是主要的限制因素。

sentences.en: The World Bank launched a new strategy to expand credit using digital tools.
sentences.zh: 世界銀行推出了一項新策略，利用數位工具擴大信貸。
